component.name: FREQUENZ
component.summary: Native, local and ad-free radio globe

description.p: FREQUENZ turns the globe into a radio dial. Spin the earth, pick a place and listen to its live stations. Browsing, search and favourites work from a local catalog; only the audio stream needs the network.

ul.li: OpenGL globe built from Natural Earth data, lit by the real sun for the current time
About 12,900 places with their stations, searchable offline
Live ICY titles, automatic reconnect, favourites and history
No ads, no accounts and no tracking

description.p: FREQUENZ is an unofficial client for radio.garden. Station names, place data and streams belong to radio.garden and the broadcasters.
New application icon and AppStream metadata, Flatpak packaging, and a code-review pass over catalog sync, playback teardown and the globe.
